description: Covers B10, B13, B24, B49. A .githooks/commit-msg that refuses a commit whose last paragraph has no Claude-Session: trailer, opt-in from wsc.toml (B10); a gate that every repo path a runs/**/README.md names exists (B13); a lint for moved-away */core/ paths in core files, fixing harness/job.sh line 5 (B24); jobs check fails when [views] commit = true beside a jobs registry, naming C19, and policy adds a C19 hint to its brief-branch refusal (B49).
title: Guards: commit-msg trailer hook, run-README references, stale moved paths, committed views beside a jobs registry
